reason: Independent pre-review required dev model selection not to rely only on the mean-replicate label and obscure a single-repeat failure. This amendment is frozen before any target test inference or test MRL reading; it does not alter training data, model grids, test pools, caps, success thresholds or evaluation results.
selection_rule: For every main, MSE-only and from-scratch candidate, compute cap16 regret separately with measured dev r1 and dev r2 using the equal-weight three-seed ensemble and the same proposals. Minimize the worse (maximum) of the two repeat-specific regrets. Ties within 1e-12 use mean-replicate cap16 regret, then mean dev combined objective, lower LR and lower lambda.
train_repeat_equal_weight: The original frozen arithmetic mean (r1+r2)/2 is retained. For MSE this is exactly equal to 1/2 MSE(r1)+1/2 MSE(r2) up to a parameter-independent constant; each repeat therefore has equal 1/2 label weight. Pairwise supervision remains the preregistered mean-replicate target.
three_seed_equal_weight: Every dev and test ensemble is the arithmetic mean of seeds 11/23/37 at their individually natural-converged best checkpoints; no seed is dropped or reweighted.
from_scratch_fairness: From-scratch retains the same architecture, target train/dev data, mean-replicate labels, 3x3 LR-lambda grid, three seeds, DualPlateau and worst-repeat dev selection as fine-tuned main.
nested_rule: Nested budgets must use the amended selected main LR/lambda. If the earlier mean-only selection differs, earlier nested runs are preserved as superseded development artifacts and excluded from the final 72-run freeze; replacement nested runs use identical budgets and rules.
test_rule: All amendment, dev repeat labels, selections and required replacement nested runs must freeze before the single test evaluation. No test result is available at amendment time and no post-test change is allowed.
